baseline_rules.turn: 1 standard +1 move +1 reaction +free; full consumes standard/move/usually reaction
baseline_rules.attack: 2d6+FOR or DES when allowed +Luta proficiency, result strictly greater defense
baseline_rules.defender: 6+CON+Armour+Fortitude bonus; if not exceeded no damage
baseline_rules.dodge: CA+Reflexo proficiency; counter on failed opponent hit if reaction
baseline_rules.critical: seq3d6 + special max dice; spell critical forbidden; timing/rider interaction pending
baseline_rules.RD: Besta Prata normal15 / Prata Titã30; Liu historical RDF10, resolver RD stack/type priority
baseline_rules.magic: cost from PA Libre; default one standard action if not specified; no universal cast roll
baseline_rules.weakness: additional 3 rolls of largest elemental die on applicable weaknesses only
baseline_rules.transformation: T9-A one use per scene, next scene after a complete short/long rest following prior use; Liu cannot be assumed ready
baseline_rules.defeat: source-specific threshold not certified; PA insufficiency exhaustion collapses per Sistema de Magia
